items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: We all went to Mary's funeral. ... Now, Mary called me and told me that she got a telephone call from the Australian Ambassador...

ctx.x: Yes, and PeeWee, now think, PeeWee -- Rutger*s University gave PeeWee a show, now we got a call. Before Mary died, Mary died about a year before PeeWee.
Yes, nine months to a year.
